organiser.name: Asalto (asalto.org), co-organised with Ayuntamiento de Zaragoza

attendance.note: Aragón TV report title (Google snippet): '3.000 visitantes han disfrutado en Torrero-La Paz del arte urbano del festival Asalto' (2024 edition). Likely counts activities and tours, not everyone who saw the public murals. A 2025 Aragón Play article cites '55.000 asistentes' without a clear scope (possibly cumulative).

notes: Organised by the Asalto association with Zaragoza city council; funded mainly by public bodies, with 2025 commercial sponsors Embou (telco), Ambar (beer), Maquinza, Montana Colors, Cafés Orús and the city tram. Strong social and community focus (migrants, older people, health centre mural in 2026). No email published. IG @festivalasalto is correct.
